milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining the trapped chest causes its contents (9 coal) to drop and be picked up by the player. The coal ending up in inventory is the meaningful outcome of breaking the chest. Also uses count_in_box_at_most to verify the trapped_chest block at position (2,0,2) relative to spawn has been destroyed (no longer exists as a block).

Uses inventory_has because crafting a coal_block places the finished item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no coal_block, so having ≥1 confirms successful crafting of the 9-coal recipe.
